title: Space Florida Annual Report 2025 — Phase 65 Florida Space Coast authority and mission delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Florida Space Coast authority and mission delivery reporting pack. Space Florida's 2025 annual report records the state development authority's portfolio, capital activity, partnerships, and infrastructure narrative, creating a consolidated lead source for project-level follow-up.
key_findings: The report connects Florida's space economic-development strategy to named programs, transactions, partnerships, and infrastructure activity.
It provides a portfolio-level view that can be decomposed into project, award, contract, construction, and operating records.
Agency-reported activity and impact framing require project-level and outcome verification before supporting delivery claims.
why_it_matters: Which records connect licences, operators, infrastructure capital, construction, accepted facilities, mission use, safety, and repeat operations? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The report is a high-density discovery document for tracing state economic-development claims into named assets and measured results.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a locally captured Florida portfolio record.
Connects finance, infrastructure, institutions, and commercial-space development.
Provides candidate trails for awards, construction, utilization, jobs, and outcomes.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The report is an agency account and is not independent verification of every project claim.
Portfolio activity does not establish completion or use for each named asset.
Financial, employment, utilization, and economic-impact claims require their underlying methods and project records.
